STARFALL SALVAGE - CREDITS AND NOTICE SCOPE

Game by Stephan Arrington, with OpenAI Codex assistance for design,
the eighteen-mission Story campaign, Arcade mode, native implementation,
original pixel artwork, six-zone chiptune composition and sound effects,
and the instruction booklet.

The illustrated box art in the manual was generated with the built-in
image generation tool. It is not a native game frame. The manual's nine
gameplay screenshots are unaltered version 1.1 native-emulator captures.

Built with GB Studio by Chris Maltby and contributors:
https://www.gbstudio.dev/

Built with GBDK-2020 by its contributors:
https://gbdk.org/

The booklet was prepared with ReportLab.

THIRD-PARTY NOTICE
LICENSE contains the retained GB Studio MIT notice naming Chris Maltby,
unchanged from the project. Third-party components retain their own terms.
This notice is not a new licensing choice for the original game content.

LOCAL DRAFT / AUTHOR REVIEW
The author's distribution terms for original code, art and music are still
being finalized. The provenance and attribution of retained UI/font assets
also need review before public distribution. This package preserves the
existing notice without asserting that it settles those original-content
or asset-provenance questions.
